text.description_html:
Hamilton DBP-102-BP Large Round Doorbell Button Plate

This bronze patina doorbell button plate is 3 inches in diameter. It is cast in solid bronze. The round design makes this doorbell button cover a simple and inexpensive way to add classic elegance to your home. It is easy to install with the matching finish mounting screws; and is made with the attention to quality that Hamilton Sinkler is known for.

Also available: Small Round Door Bell Button

Specifications for Hamilton DBP-102-BP Bronze Doorbell Cover:

  • Diameter: 3"
  • 3/8" Thick Solid Bronze
  • Finish: Bronze Patina
  • Packaged with matching finish mounting screws
  • Hamilton DBP-102-BP Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
